name: ma-thanksgiving-holiday-policy
summary: Three Worcester, Massachusetts workers at $19.00/h, billed at $27.00/h, in Thanksgiving week 2026 (Thursday November 26). The agency's holiday policy (agency data: no law here requires holiday pay) pays 1.5× for hours worked on the holiday and 8 hours for a holiday not worked when a person confirms the worker is eligible; it bills worked holiday hours at 1.5× and does not bill a holiday not worked. Worker A works 8 hours Monday to Friday: 40 h × $19 = $760.00 plus the holiday premium 8 h × 0.5 × $19 = $76.00 = $836.00; billed 40 h × $27 + 8 h × $13.50 = $1,188.00. Worker B works 8 hours on the four other days and is confirmed eligible for the holiday: 32 h × $19 = $608.00 plus 8 h of holiday pay × $19 = $152.00 = $760.00, which is not hours worked (no overtime from it); billed 32 h × $27 = $864.00. Worker C works 9 hours a day (45 h): 40 h × $19 = $760.00, overtime 5 h × $28.50 = $142.50, and the holiday premium on Thursday's 9 hours, 9 h × $9.50 = $85.50, paid on top of the overtime (a 1.5× holiday premium stays out of the regular rate: 29 U.S.C. § 207(e)(6)) = $988.00; billed 40 h × $27 + 5 h × $40.50 + 9 h × $13.50 = $1,404.00.

payLines.explain: Regular: 40h 00m (2400 min) × $19.00/h = 76000¢ exactly → $760.00. Rule straight_time: hours up to the 40h 00m weekly threshold in the workweek starting 2026-11-23.

Holiday premium: 8h 00m (480 min) × $9.50/h (0.5 × $19.00) = 7600¢ exactly → $76.00. Rule holiday_worked: 2026-11-26 is a holiday under the holiday policy "Agency holidays", which pays 1.5 × the pay rate for hours worked; straight time is on the regular and overtime lines, and this premium is paid on top of any overtime, never credited toward it. A holiday premium of 1.5× or more is not counted in the regular rate (29 U.S.C. § 207(e)(6); 29 C.F.R. §§ 778.203, 778.219).
Regular: 32h 00m (1920 min) × $19.00/h = 60800¢ exactly → $608.00. Rule straight_time: hours up to the 40h 00m weekly threshold in the workweek starting 2026-11-23.

Holiday pay (not worked): 8h 00m (480 min) × $19.00/h (the agreed pay rate) = 15200¢ exactly → $152.00. Rule holiday_not_worked: 2026-11-26 is a holiday under the holiday policy "Agency holidays", the worker did not work that day, and a person confirmed the worker is eligible; it is pay, not hours worked, so it counts toward neither overtime nor the regular rate (29 U.S.C. § 207(e)(2); 29 C.F.R. §§ 778.218, 778.219).

Part 778 — over 40 hours in a workweek at not less than 1.5x the regular rate).
